name: OB-Xd
description: Open-source emulation of the Oberheim OB-X and OB-Xa polyphonic synthesizers.
about:
An emulation of the Oberheim OB-X, OB-Xa and OB-8 polyphonic analog synthesizers, with the warm detuned voice character those instruments are known for.

Open source, with a large community preset library.
notes: Windows installer is Inno Setup (verified by signature). The macOS .pkg is run with administrator privileges through osascript.
